Class PipelineTimings

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.PipelineTimings
@Internal public final class PipelineTimings extends Object
The time the stages of the Python pipeline take, accumulated per stage when the system property "micronaut.python.timings" is set: the benchmarks read them to attribute the cost of a compilation to the GraalPy context, the transform, the model, the type checker, the planner, the bytecode and the generated classes. Off by default, when the stages cost one static boolean read each.
Since:
5.3.0
